summary: Apply row/column edits to protected cell rectangles, output merged canonical rectangles

traps.quote: every maximal consecutive sequence of rows on which that exact interval occurs becomes one
traps.consequence: Output lists column-intervals per-row instead of merging rows with identical protected-column spans
traps.guard: After computing final protected cells per row, group and merge consecutive rows sharing column intervals

traps.quote: Edit index 1 <= index <= dimension, but rectangle coordinate indexing scheme: not stated
traps.consequence: Off-by-one errors applying 1-indexed edits to 0-indexed rectangles or vice versa
traps.guard: Establish whether rectangles are 0-indexed or 1-indexed; apply all edits in consistent indexing space

traps.quote: cells moved beyond the fixed worksheet boundary are discarded
traps.consequence: Rectangles extending into rows/columns beyond max_row/max_col after insertion incorrectly survive
traps.guard: After each insertion, remove or clip rectangles with indices beyond max_row or max_col

traps.quote: Do not enumerate individual worksheet cells or rows. Dimensions at most 10^9
traps.consequence: Out-of-memory or timeout attempting to materialize or loop through 10^9-row worksheet
traps.guard: Represent worksheet implicitly; track only rectangles as tuples, never iterate rows or create grid

traps.quote: Delete lines index through index+d-1... final d lines become unprotected
traps.consequence: Rectangles in deletion range clipped incorrectly, or final d lines incorrectly remain protected
traps.guard: Clip rectangles intersecting [index,index+d-1] completely; ensure rows (max_row-d+1..max_row) become unprotected

traps.quote: 30,000 edits, 150,000 rectangles, output 200,000 intervals. Do not enumerate
traps.consequence: TLE from O(edits × rectangles) loop tracking each rectangle independently through all edits
traps.guard: Use efficient interval merging per edit (union, overlap detection); merge overlapping rectangles

input_shape: ranges (≤30k rectangles), edits (≤30k row/col inserts/deletes), max_row/max_col (≤10^9)
output_shape: Lexicographically sorted list of (r1,c1,r2,c2) rectangles, canonical merged form
invariants: Worksheet dimensions remain max_row × max_col throughout all edits
Output rectangles are disjoint, merged by row-run, sorted lexicographically
Inserted lines are unprotected; cells moved beyond max_row are discarded
max_scale: 30k rectangles, 30k edits, 10^9 dimensions, intermediate 150k rectangles, output ≤200k
